english.title: Dispose of relieved goods to be used by another for a purpose contrary to a condition upon which relief was granted
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) disposed of goods, namely **(..SPECIFY GOODS..), on which relief from payment of

(A)_[a relevant levy]_
(B)_[a duty of excise]_
(C)_[value added tax]_
(D)_[car tax]_

chargeable had been conferred, for use by a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), for a purpose that was not permitted by a condition of that relief with intent to evade payment of tax or duty that

(E)_[became]_
(F)_[by reason of the acquisition or use became or would become]_

payable
english.legislation: Contrary to section 13C(2)(b) and (4) of the Customs and Excise Duties (General Reliefs) Act 1979.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding £20,000 or three times the value of the goods (whichever is the greater).
Indictment: maximum seven years imprisonment and / or a fine.Time limit for prosecutions:
None
